semantics.detection_trigger: Process execution of dual-use remote admin utility or IoA rule pattern
semantics.observed_action: UltraViewer_Service.exe or MEGAsync.exe launched by services.exe
semantics.authorization_distinction: Unknown authorization in SIEM alert is NOT proof of unauthorized policy violation; requires ITSM verification
semantics.maliciousness_distinction: Process execution of dual-use software without payload or credential dumping does NOT constitute confirmed breach
semantics.outcome_distinction: Falcon EPP blocked/killed the process, mitigating host persistence

verdict_taxonomy.TRUE_POSITIVE: Confirmed unauthorized adversary installation/execution or active malicious session establishing external C2
verdict_taxonomy.FALSE_POSITIVE: Authorized administrative remote support, scheduled deployment, or pre-approved maintenance
verdict_taxonomy.REQUIRES_ATTENTION: Dual-use remote tool observed without ITSM authorization record or live session logs

semantics.detection_trigger: Perimeter gateway HTTP transfer flagged by threat signature or extension
semantics.observed_action: HTTP GET transfer of JavaScript asset or PE executable
semantics.authorization_distinction: Public CDN and SaaS browsing is expected corporate traffic
semantics.maliciousness_distinction: Standard jQuery/SaaS UI libraries are benign; executables require WildFire sandbox detonation
semantics.outcome_distinction: Gateway permitted transfer; endpoint impact requires host telemetry

verdict_taxonomy.TRUE_POSITIVE: Confirmed malware payload, malicious script beacon, or exploit confirmed by WildFire or threat intelligence
verdict_taxonomy.FALSE_POSITIVE: Standard web asset, stylesheet, or SaaS analytics library downloaded during normal browsing
verdict_taxonomy.REQUIRES_ATTENTION: Unclassified executable binary (e.g. update.exe) without sandbox detonation report
